episodes.title: Boy Smells Rat
episodes.summary: Eli starts the day with a turbulent driving lesson from Slim. School bullies confront Eli with a challenge, but a teacher catches them in the act.

episodes.title: Boy Gets Chop
episodes.summary: Lyle shows Eli and Gus around his workplace and introduces them to his boss, Tytus Broz. Later, a surprise visit to Eli's house leads to trouble.

episodes.title: Run Boy Run
episodes.summary: Frankie gets herself in trouble for protecting her sons. Eli searches for a way back home to look for his stepdad — and his missing stash.

episodes.title: Boy Loses Dad
episodes.summary: Caitlyn continues investigating Lyle's disappearance. Accompanied by police, the school's guidance counselor checks on the boys.

episodes.title: Boy Takes Flight
episodes.summary: Eli asks for a big favor from Slim's old acquaintance and comes across a major clue about Lyle's disappearance.

episodes.title: Boy Seeks Work
episodes.summary: Eli and Gus show Frankie what they've planned for their future. Later, Eli attempts to get a job as a journalist at the local paper.

episodes.title: Boy Meets End
episodes.summary: Eli finds an unlikely source for a story to submit to The Courier-Mail. New evidence leads Caitlyn to uncover the truth about the criminal underworld.
